CLASS TRAITS

Role: Leader. You lead by healing and shielding allies with your prayers.

Power Source: Divine. You are a divine leader, a holy warrior.

Key Abilities: Wisdom, Strength

Armor Proficiencies: Cloth, leather, hide, chainmail; light shields.

Weapon Proficiencies: Simple melee, simple ranged

Implements: Holy symbols

Bonuses to Defenses: +2 Will

Hit Points at 1st Level: 12+ Constitution score

Hit Points per Level Gained: 5

Healing Surges per Day: 7+ Constitution modifier

Trained Skills: Religion. From the class skills list below, choose 3 more trained skills at 1st level.

Class Skills: Arcana (Trained only), Diplomacy, Heal, History, Insight, Religion

Build Options: Templar, Warpriest, Devout

Cleric (Templar) Features

Templar features focus on control and healing.
